generation_policy: No image or font was generated, redrawn or re-vectorised. Every raster is derived from a user-supplied original: straight alpha solved from the original black-ground composite, interior pixels kept fully opaque and unpremultiplied, resampled in premultiplied space. Screenshots and fonts follow their own entries.
provenance_embedding: impeccable embed-prompt: illustration and logo WebP origins are stored in their matching .webp.json sidecars. The runtime app captures were copied without a prompt chunk; their WebP derivatives are documented below.

supplied_originals.note: Originals preserved byte-for-byte; every shipped raster above is derived only from these, with no redraw and no generative model.

assets.subject: SIL Open Font License 1.1 for Manrope
Peachy mark: translucent sculpted graphite P with rounded dusty-pink inset
assets.transformation: Exact supplied artwork. Source has no alpha channel (RGB over pure black, background measured at 0..2/255). Straight alpha derived from the real composite: border flood for the ground, largest real body as the silhouette, every interior pixel (including the darkest graphite shading and the pink inset) kept at alpha 1 and its original colour, and the 1-2 px anti-aliased edge solved as coverage alpha = C/F against the nearest fully covered interior colour, then unpremultiplied. Kept pixels recomposite over black to the source byte-exactly (max error 0/255). Only the detached <=7/255 render fringe ring (2.6k px, <=2.5% brightness) was dropped rather than shipped as translucent dirt; no geometric clip and no shape approximation. Trimmed with an 8 px pad. Lossless RGBA PNG, 585x748, the lossless alpha source for native and web use.
